The system comprises multiple ESP32 nodes forming a repeater network. A designated "Gateway" node connects to an external WAN (Wide Area Network) and acts as the internet gateway for the entire network. All other nodes (Repeater nodes) extend the network coverage by connecting to the Gateway or another Repeater node's AP and creating their own AP for downstream devices or repeaters.
Client devices connect to any node's AP interface and are redirected to a captive portal hosted on the Gateway node for internet access authentication.
